request: At ShareLinkViewSet.create handler entry, can an authenticated caller with global add_sharelink and global view_document permission create a share link for a document owned by someone else when the caller lacks object view_document permission on that document?

policySources.text: Share-link creation requires the share-link creation permission and view access to the referenced document; a global view_document grant alone does not substitute for the owner-aware object check.
